items: [fix] The empty-notes placeholder no longer reaches a release. The placeholder line `bump_version.py` writes was left under the real notes in v1.123.14 to v1.123.19 and GitHub showed it. Removed from the changelog, and a new test (`test_changelog_notes.py`) fails while the line is anywhere: `publish.ps1` runs the tests, so such a release cannot be published.
release.title: v1.124.56 — Release notes without the placeholder
